note: What fixtures/gowin-gw1n1-mux8.v computes, taken from Icarus Verilog simulating that source directly - NOT from the recovered netlist.
testbench: generated beside the source; each output is a full truth table
reading: inputs names the source ports from least-significant bit upward: input vector v drives bit k of the design with (v >> k) & 1. Each output string is hexadecimal, one character per FOUR consecutive input vectors: character c covers vectors 4c..4c+3, and vector 4c+j is bit (1 << j) of that character.
